description: This file implements UART multiplexing driver for Zephyr RTOS, managing multiple UART channels, ring buffers, and GSM DLCI channels, including initialization, data transmission, reception, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: uart_mux_cb_work
methods.description: Callback worker that invokes the user-defined callback for UART mux events.

methods.name: uart_mux_consume_ringbuf
methods.description: Consumes data from the ring buffer and passes it to GSM mux API.

methods.name: uart_mux_rx_work
methods.description: Worker that processes received data from ring buffer.

methods.name: uart_mux_tx_work
methods.description: Worker that transmits data from ring buffer to UART.

methods.name: uart_mux_init
methods.description: Initializes UART mux device, registers with Zephyr init system.

methods.name: uart_mux_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for UART, reads data into ring buffer.

methods.name: init_real_uart
methods.description: Initializes the real UART device and associates it with GSM mux.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Binds a physical UART device to a muxed UART, creates DLCI channel.

methods.name: uart_mux_poll_out
methods.description: Poll out method, sends a character via DLCI.

methods.name: uart_mux_fifo_fill
methods.description: Fills FIFO buffer with data to transmit.

methods.name: uart_mux_irq_tx_ready
methods.description: Checks if UART TX is ready.

methods.name: uart_mux_irq_rx_ready
methods.description: Checks if UART RX is ready.

methods.name: uart_mux_irq_is_pending
methods.description: Checks if any UART interrupt is pending.

methods.name: z_impl_uart_mux_find
methods.description: Finds UART device by DLCI address.

methods.name: uart_mux_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all UART mux devices.
